## Summary

I successfully resolved ticket T-4005. The issue was caused by storefront-web 3.0 failing to connect to the OpenTelemetry collector service, which resulted in repeated connection refused errors and a full export queue. This prevented the application from functioning properly, causing 502 Bad Gateway errors to be returned by ingress-nginx, even though the pods appeared healthy in Kubernetes. The fix requires either ensuring the OTel collector is available and accessible, or configuring storefront-web 3.0 to gracefully handle unavailable observability services without impacting request processing.
